data.title: Trace every *claim*
data.subtitle: Habit 16. Ask where each number, name and date came from.

rows: Open the link, read around the quote

items: Quotes can **sound authoritative** and not be grounded
Claude isn't your **only source of truth**
Click the ones your point depends on
The page may hold context the summary left out

blocks.text: List every number, name, date and quote in your answer. For each, say where it came from: my file, a web source (with the link) or your general knowledge. Mark anything you're not sure of.
From Anthropic's guide: ask for a **supporting quote** for each claim, and have Claude **retract** any it can't support.
It reduces mistakes. It doesn't remove them.
